researchDepth: Bounded seven-Driver landscape, exact-source and existing-edge review. Selected primary retrieval methods/figures plus abstracts/syntheses and contradiction checks; not a formal systematic review per Driver.

entityReviews.constructReview: Confidence in one specified causal proposition, not whether the proposition is true or its objective causal magnitude.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Causal-rating response format changes observed judgment; unidirectional versus bidirectional scales are not interchangeable. Correct conditional-probability learning does not guarantee correct causal integration.
entityReviews.timeReview: Belief after observed outcomes separated from prior confidence and real outcome generation.
entityReviews.unresolved: Existing veracity→causal-belief mechanism concerns accuracy, whereas target is confidence/strength. No accuracy repair or numerical causal weight.

entityReviews.constructReview: Connected, internally noncontradictory representation supporting inference; internal coherence does not establish external truth.
entityReviews.measurementReview: External concept maps and test performance are imperfect indicators, not direct observations of all internal connections or a real social network.
entityReviews.timeReview: Learning/organization across sessions versus momentary inference; no assumed instant restructuring.
entityReviews.unresolved: Concept-mapping learning outcomes do not establish exact internal coherence or complete knowledge organization; STRUCTURE search stays insufficient.

entityReviews.constructReview: Amount AND organization of accurate domain knowledge, a multidimensional profile, not any retained text.
entityReviews.measurementReview: A recall score can be inaccurate, narrow or disorganized. Selected idea-unit recall is not whole-profile increase; concept-map accuracy and domain coverage must be checked.
entityReviews.timeReview: Durable knowledge versus current cue accessibility and practice performance; no universal transfer.
entityReviews.unresolved: Existing feature-scope architecture question applies to multidimensional knowledge; no generic signed whole-construct effect from one score.

entityReviews.constructReview: Retrieval readiness of specified material under current cues; probability and latency are canonical indicators but different estimands.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Delayed title-cued recall probability of scored idea units aligns to that specific material/cue. Not storage capacity, general memory ability, knowledge accuracy or all cues.
entityReviews.timeReview: Five-minute result reverses delayed advantage in primary study; candidate restricted to two-day/one-week tests, not universal persistence.
entityReviews.unresolved: One bounded delayed-recall effect retained; no unsupported generalization to recognition, all intervals, aging or clinical memory.

entityReviews.constructReview: Feeling previously encountered/known, not actual repetition, accurate recollection or objective familiarity count.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Subjective familiarity distinguished from ease and recognition accuracy; attribution and expectations matter.
entityReviews.timeReview: Exposure history and later felt familiarity distinct; frozen weeks/months metadata does not prohibit studying a bounded state but is not repaired.
entityReviews.unresolved: Reuse repeated-claim identity and existing fluency review; no new universal familiarity effect or belief-truth equivalence.

entityReviews.constructReview: Confidence that a particular recollection is accurate, not actual accuracy or confidence in future learning.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Current and retrospective certainty differ; initial uncontaminated lineup confidence and post-feedback confidence cannot be pooled. A future recall prediction is not this Driver.
entityReviews.timeReview: Immediate identification certainty versus later contaminated reporting; no timeless confidence-accuracy equivalence.
entityReviews.unresolved: Feedback effect remains research-needed until exact current-confidence contrast is extracted. SRC184 stored PMID wrong; intended source documented without repair.

entityReviews.constructReview: Perceived fit of new information to existing beliefs; distinct from objective agreement or truth.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Perceived congruence needs an aligned report/manipulation check; schema-consistent false recall and counterargument production are different outcomes.
entityReviews.timeReview: Prior belief precedes message and perceived fit; counterarguing can reshape reported fit, requiring separated measurements.
entityReviews.unresolved: No formal semantic equality or causal effect from confirmation-bias theory alone; REL-PSY-033 remains research-needed.

existingReviews.rationale: Retain bounded repetition→felt familiarity interpretation with realized recipient exposure; repetition explicitly does not establish truth.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Corpus exposure frequency is not each person's dose. Framework/source-taxonomy references do not supply exact current lag, saturation or independent subjective-familiarity contrast.
existingReviews.rdsReview: No local RDS or incident RDS endpoint. Mental maps and causal beliefs are psychological representations, not scientific Relationships, social ties or calculational weights.
existingReviews.executionReview: Production remains unchanged/legacy incomplete; no inferred lag, magnitude, pathway, new executability or activation.

existingReviews.rationale: Current mechanism describes accuracy of causal beliefs, but PSY-063 is confidence in a specified causal proposition; veracity, acceptance, strength and calibration remain distinct.
existingReviews.nullContrary: False contingencies can be confidently endorsed; rating scales influence strength scores. Context-dependent sign does not resolve target mismatch.
existingReviews.proposal: Future adjudication must distinguish strength/confidence from accuracy; specify exposed causal proposition, verified content, baseline belief, actual acceptance and subsequent confidence. No new accuracy endpoint or universal increase/decrease is proposed.
existingReviews.rdsReview: No local RDS or incident RDS endpoint. Mental maps and causal beliefs are psychological representations, not scientific Relationships, social ties or calculational weights.
existingReviews.executionReview: Production remains unchanged/legacy incomplete; no inferred lag, magnitude, pathway, new executability or activation.

existingReviews.rationale: Confirmation-bias/ELM theory suggests selective processing, but perceived congruence and exact counterarguing intensity require separate manipulation/measurement.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Source117 locator concern; selective evidence preference/acceptance is not measured counterarguing. Reverse inference from counterarguments to perceived fit may be circular.
existingReviews.rdsReview: No local RDS or incident RDS endpoint. Mental maps and causal beliefs are psychological representations, not scientific Relationships, social ties or calculational weights.
existingReviews.executionReview: Production remains unchanged/legacy incomplete; no inferred lag, magnitude, pathway, new executability or activation.

hypotheses.question: Title-cued free-recall practice increases later accessibility of the specified prose.
hypotheses.reason: Exact delayed candidate EA0012; primary equal-time comparison supports recall probability at two days/one week. Five-minute contrary result is excluded from signed scope, not discarded.

hypotheses.question: Retrieval practice always improves immediate recall.
hypotheses.reason: Restudy advantage at five minutes in both primary experiments contradicts universal timing.

hypotheses.question: Higher prose recall means the whole Domain Knowledge profile increased.
hypotheses.reason: Recall probability under one cue is not accurate domain coverage plus organization.

hypotheses.question: Future-learning prediction is current Memory Confidence.
hypotheses.reason: Predicting next week's recall and judging current recollection accuracy are different estimands.

hypotheses.question: Confirming identification feedback increases current Memory Confidence.
hypotheses.reason: Current versus retrospective ratings, correct/incorrect IDs and latency must be disaggregated before signing exact effect.

hypotheses.question: High memory confidence proves accuracy.
hypotheses.reason: Initial pristine-lineup association is conditional; feedback can inflate certainty without improving identification.

hypotheses.question: Outcome density increases causal-belief strength.
hypotheses.reason: Simulated contingencies and rating-format effects are not exact canonical exposure Driver; no invented entity or causal coefficient.

hypotheses.question: Causal-belief score is a PSYWERX edge weight.
hypotheses.reason: A person's confidence in a proposition is not objective causal magnitude or executable science.

hypotheses.question: Concept mapping improves Mental Model Coherence.
hypotheses.reason: Learning scores do not directly verify internal connectedness/noncontradiction.

hypotheses.question: A concept-map/test-score gain increases all Domain Knowledge dimensions.
hypotheses.reason: Reuse Layer multidimensional feature-scope escalation; no normalized complete profile or validation of whole-construct change.

hypotheses.question: A coherent internal model is necessarily true.
hypotheses.reason: Internal consistency can organize false premises.

hypotheses.question: A concept-map connection creates a PSYWERX Relationship or social tie.
hypotheses.reason: Representation, scientific proposition and interpersonal configuration are distinct.

hypotheses.question: Environmental context reinstatement changes memory accessibility.
hypotheses.reason: Cue competition, encoding context and internal reinstatement need exact operation/endpoint mapping; no universal place effect.

hypotheses.question: Stress lowers memory accessibility.
hypotheses.reason: Direction differs by encoding/consolidation/retrieval timing and context; physiological stress not identical to PSY-054 appraisal.

hypotheses.question: Stress→cortisol→memory is an identified pathway.
hypotheses.reason: Cortisol response magnitude did not relate to memory effect in meta-analysis; pathway identification absent.

hypotheses.question: Expected digital access changes memory accessibility.
hypotheses.reason: Content versus storage-location tests differ; expectation, actual availability and future cue must align to exact endpoint.

hypotheses.question: Failed computer-word priming replication disproves every Google-memory experiment.
hypotheses.reason: Original priming and expected-storage experiments have different manipulations/outcomes.

hypotheses.question: Technology uniformly destroys enduring memory capacity.
hypotheses.reason: Task-specific costs and benefits do not establish global lasting trait change.

hypotheses.question: Confederate misinformation changes reported memory.
hypotheses.reason: Intrusions show suggestibility under specified scenes; exact accuracy/accessibility/confidence target not yet resolved.

hypotheses.question: A socially introduced false memory increases accurate knowledge.
hypotheses.reason: Accessibility of misinformation is not accurate Domain Knowledge.

hypotheses.question: Cultural background relates to memory specificity.
hypotheses.reason: Country-group comparison is not randomized culture, and recognition precision/response bias not one Family construct.

hypotheses.question: Institutional testing policy improves all students' knowledge.
hypotheses.reason: A controlled recall operation differs from grading, access, stakes and instruction; no policy effect inferred.

hypotheses.question: Prior knowledge modifies REL-PSY-033 congruence→counterarguing.
hypotheses.reason: No exact PSY-065 measurement × governed-edge interaction extracted; broad learner moderation not sufficient.

hypotheses.question: Repetition→familiarity→belief is a transmitted pathway.
hypotheses.reason: Existing separate edges and F01 total operation effect do not identify mediated transmitted effect; no double contribution.

hypotheses.question: Domain Knowledge and Memory Accessibility overlap.
hypotheses.reason: Accessible false or disorganized content differs from accurate organized knowledge; partial measurement overlap not identity.

hypotheses.question: Perceived congruence equals factual veracity.
hypotheses.reason: Felt agreement can be wrong; source strength and target accuracy mismatch remain separate.

hypotheses.question: Retrieval practice precedes better later recall as a formal temporal edge.
hypotheses.reason: An operation/outcome study does not supply an ontology-entity sequence distinct from scoped EffectAssertion; no redundant temporal record.
